1.o: في الستينيّات في مدينة "نيويورك" خلال العصر الذهبي للدعاية والإعلان المدجّج بالغرور، حيث الجميع يبيعون شيئًا ما وكل شيء ليس كما يبدو.

2.o: يستمر "دون" في إخفاء حياته الشخصية المتزايدة في التعقيد، حتى مع دعوة "روجر" له للإفصاح عنها.

3.o: يعود "بيت" من شهر العسل يملؤه الحماس بشأن زواجه الجديد، لكن مشاعره متضاربة بشأن لقائه في الماضي مع "بيغي".

4.o: يزداد تعقّد حياة "بيت" الشخصية والعملية بينما هو يصارع للسيطرة على كليهما.

5.o: يجب على "دون" التعامل مع التداعيات عندما تعيد إحدى الصور ماضيًا هو ليس مستعدًا لمواجهته.

6.o: تُثبت "بيغي" في جلسة عصف ذهني أنها أكثر من مجرد سكرتيرة.

7.o: ينضم "روجر" إلى "دون" في أمسية لتناول العشاء والشراب، لكن سلوك "روجر" خلالها يؤدي إلى تصدّع صداقتهما.

8.o: يتعذّب "دون" عندما تعود أجزاء من ماضيه السري لتقضّ مضجعه.

9.o: تتودّد وكالة إعلانية منافسة لـ "دون" باستخدام "بيتي" لاستدارجه كي يترك العمل في وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر".

10.o: يفقد "دون" حسابًا لشركة ما، ويحاول "روجر" الذي سيقضي عطلة عيد العمال في المدينة الترويح عنه.

11.o: تتيح مشاكل "روجر" في العمل فرصًا جديدًا لـ "دون"، بينما يزيد إحباط "بيت".

12.o: يقضي موظفو وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر" ليلة الانتخابات في الشركة في صخب أثناء انتظارهم للنتائج.

13.o: مع اقتراب عيد الشكر، تتداخل مسؤوليات عمل "دون" مع حياته الأُسريّة.

1.o: إنه يوم عيد الحب، وتحاول وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر" البقاء على القمة، بينما يجد "دون" و "داك" نفسيهما في مواجهة بعضهما البعض بسبب حساب شركة.

2.o: على الرغم من تضارب المصالح، تسعى وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر" بكل ما أوتيت من قوة للفوز بحساب شركة طيران.

3.o: تحدث مشكلات أثناء تصوير إعلان بينما يتغيب "دون" عن الحضور إلى المكتب.

4.o: يصطحب "بيت" و"كين" عميلًا لتناول الغداء مع رفيق يثير المشاعر في قلب "روجر ستيرلينغ".

5.o: يجد "دون" نفسه مضطرًا للتعامل مع المشاكل بين فنان كوميدي تلفزيوني "جيمي" وزوجته "بوبي"، وتعثر "جون" لـ "دون" على السكرتيرة المثالية.

6.o: يحاول "دون" و "داك" إحلال السلام بينهما، وتحاول "بيغي" حضور اجتماعات المدراء التنفيذيين بعد ساعات العمل، ويواجه "داك" زيارة عائلية.

7.o: ترتكب سكرتيرة "دون" خطأً كبيرًا وهو ما يضع "جون" في مشكلة، بينما يمتلك "كوبر" قطعة فنية جديدة في مكتبه تثير اهتمام الموظفين.

8.o: يقوم الأب "غيل" بإقناع "بيغي" أن يُساهم في مشروع تطوعي، ويحاول "دون" و "داك" اجتذاب قطاع سكاني جديد من أجل الفوز بمشروع جعة مستوردة.

9.o: يخيّب "فريدي" آمال فريقه خلال عرض تقديمي، بينما يجد "بيت" فرصة في المكتب يمكن استغلالها، في حين يثبت "دون" ولاءه لصديق قديم.

10.o: تزور "بيتي" والدها المريض، وتحاول "شيلا" إقناع "بول" في وضع أولويات لمهامه المدنية، بينما ترفض والدة "بيت" خططه هو و "ترودي".

11.o: يتعرف "دون" في "لوس أنجلوس" على أصدقاء جدد مثيرين للاهتمام، وتبحث "بيغي" عن الحبّ في الشركة، ويفكر "داك" في مستقبل "ستيرلينغ كوبر".

12.o: يقابل "دون" صديقًا قديمًا، ومستقبل أحد الأرصدة يبقى مُعلّقًا عندما تمثّل حياة "بيت" الشخصية مشكلة، بينما تصطحب "جون" حبيبها إلى العمل.

13.o: مستقبل وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر" غير واضح، والعمل لا يسير على ما يرام بدون "دون"، بينما تتلقى "بيتي" أخبارًا مقلقة.

1.o: يصبح "بيت" و "كين" من بين أولئك الذين يتأثرون بالتغيير الحادث في الشركة. وفي الوقت نفسه، ترافق "سال" "دون" في رحلة عمل.

2.o: يقوم والد "بيتي" بزيارتها، وتفكر الشركة في طلب غير معتاد لأحد عملائها، وينظّم "روجر" حفل زفاف، بينما تتأثر "بيغي" بشدة بحملة دعائية.

3.o: تؤدي جلسة عمل بعد المواعيد الرسمية إلى مواجهة الكُتّاب لملل ليلي، ويقيم "روجر" حفلًا، كما يقوم "جون" و "غريغ" باستضافة حفل خاص بهما.

4.o: يقابل "دون" والد زوجته، وتبحث "بيغي" عن زميلة سكن جديدة، بينما يتحمّس عميل ثري للعمل مع الشركة.

5.o: يعمل "بيت" بشكلٍ جديد في صفقاته، ويُضطر "دون" و "بيتي" أن يتصرفا بشأن سلوك "سالي" المقلق، بينما يؤثر حلم على "بيتي" بشكلٍ غريب.

6.t: Guy Walks Into an Advertising Agency
6.o: يظهر زائر غير متوقع في وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر"، ويثير شيء ما (أو شخص ما) خوف "سالي"، بينما تتلقى "جون" أخبارًا مفاجئة.

7.o: تنخرط "بيتي" في السياسات المحلية، ويقود حادث مقلق "دون" للتفكير في مستقبله، بينما تتلقى "بيغي" هدية رائعة.

8.o: يقرر "دون" اصطحاب "بيتي" في رحلة عمل للوكالة، بينما يقدّم "بيت" المساعدة لِجار له في مبنى شقّته.

9.o: يواجه "دون" و "سال" صعوبة في إرضاء أحد العملاء، بينما تقرر "بيتي" استضافة حفل خيري لجمع التبرعات.

10.o: تحتفل وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر" بحدث هام في تاريخها، بينما تتنافس "بيغي" و "بول" من أجل الفوز بحساب إحدى الشركات.

11.o: ترحب وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر" بعميل سخيّ مرة أخرى، وتصطحب "بيتي" الأولاد في رحلة، بينما يخطط "جون" و "غريغ" لمستقبلهما.

12.o: يترك مرشّح أثرًا في "دون"، وتثبت "بيغي" أن ذوقها في الرجال مشكوكٌ فيه، بينما يواجه "بيت" قرارًا حاسمًا بشأن مستقبله الوظيفي.

13.t: Shut the Door. Have a Seat
13.o: يعقد "دون" اجتماعًا مهمًا مع "كوني"، وتستفيد "بيتي" من نصيحة مثيرة للاهتمام، بينما يعقد "بيت" اجتماعًا جادًا مع "دون" و "روجر".

1.o: يفسد رفض "دون" الحديث عن نفسه مقابلةً مع شركة رفيعة المستوى لتجارة الورق كانت تأمل أن تكون المقابلة خطوة إيجابية للعمل.

2.t: Christmas Comes But Once a Year
2.ar: عيد الميلاد يزورنا مرة واحدة في السنة
2.o: يوشك احتفال الشركة بعيد الميلاد أن يفشل بسبب الوصول المُتأخر المفاجئ والغير مرحب به لأحد الزائرين.

3.o: يذهب "دون" في رحلة قصيرة إلى "أكابولكو"، بينما ينشب خلاف جدّي بين "جون" و "لين" في الشركة.

4.o: يضع قرار صادر من "روجر" و "لين" "بيت" في معضلة شخصية.

5.o: يتجاهل "دون" و "بيت" تطلعات "روجر" من أجل الفوز بعميل جديد مهم.

6.o: تختلف "بيغي" مع شريكها الإبداعي الجديد، بينما يقدّم "دون" عرضًا تقديميًا تحت ظروف غير معتادة.

7.o: يثير موعد نهائي الفوضى في وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر دريبر برايس".

8.o: تُضطر "جون" و "بيغي" للتعامل مع إشكالات العمل المزعجة.

9.o: قد تثير لفتة رومانسية في شكل هدية مدروسة المشاكل المهنية لـ "بيغي".

10.o: تضطرب "بيتي" قليلًا عندما يُعرّج زائر مفاجئ على منزل "فرانسيس".

11.o: يتم استدعاء كل موظفي وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر دريبر برايس" لاجتماع عاجل... وتبدأ الشائعات في الانتشار.

12.o: أثناء محاولته تفادي أزمة، يلتقي "دون" بصديق قديم.

13.o: في ختام الموسم الرابع، يواجه "دون" و "بيغي" فرصة مفاجئة تجعلهما يفكران في قرارات مصيرية.

1.o: يُسافر "دون" إلى "لوس أنجلوس" في محاولة للحفاظ على زواجه، بينما تُصلح صحوة روحية الأمور بين "روجر" و "مارغريت".

2.o: ترتكب "بيغي" خطأً محرجًا يوم عيد الحب، ويساعد "كاتلر" "جون" في الترقي، بينما يسهم سرّان في التقريب بين "دون" و "سالي".

3.o: بعد طرد "ميغان" له، ينجح "دون" في العودة إلى العمل في وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر وشركاه"، وتحاول "بيتي" التقرب من "بوبي" خلال رحلة مدرسية.

4.o: يجب على "بيغي" الإشراف على "دون" أثناء توليها مسؤولية رصيد جديد مهم، ويحاول "روجر" استعادة "مارغريت" الهاربة من مجتمع من الهيبيز.

5.o: يسيطر "دون" على حساب بالقوة لترسيخ أقدامه في وكالة "ستيرلينغ كوبر وشركاه"، ويضغط "هنري" على "برايس" للتقليل من حدة آرائها السياسية.

6.o: يطلب "بوب" الزواج من "جون" عندما يكتشف أنه سيتولى وظيفة جديدة، بينما تعترف "بيغي" لـ "دون" بمخاوفها بشأن حملة الرصيد الجديد.

7.o: يتساجل "روجر" و "كاتلر" بشأن مستقبل "ستيرلينغ كوبر وشركاه" ووضع "دون" بها، بينما تستعد "ميغان" للتخلي عن زواجها، ويمرّ "تيد" بانهيار.

8.o: يختبر "دون" رؤية سابقة وتهزه بعض الأخبار لاحقًا، وتتحمل "بيغي" و "جون" اجتماعًا فظًا وتذهب "بيغي" في موعد غرامي ويواجه "كين" مفترق طرق.

9.o: يجد "دون" الراحة لدى شخصية مشابهة له، وتسيطر مخاوف "ستان" عليه، ويعود "روجر" لنزوة من الماضي، ويسدي "هاري" نصيحة مهنيّة لـ "ميغان".

10.o: يؤدي خلط في الهويات إلى حصول "جون" على موعد رومانسي، ويفكر "دون" في إلهامات شخصية وعملية، وتتلقى "سالي" أخبارًا سيئة من صديق قديم.

11.o: يؤدي تغيير في خطط الشركة في إثارة قلق شركاء الوكالة، وتطلب "ترودي" من "بيت" حل مشكلة منزلية، بينما تُصارح "بيغي" "ستان" بماضيها.

12.o: يذهب "دون" في مهمة بحث بعيدة، وتصرّ "بيغي" على موقفها منتظرةً الحصول على ما تستحقه، بينما تندم "جون" على طلب المساعدة من زميل عمل.

13.o: تتلقى "بيتي" و "هنري" أخبارًا تغيّر حياتهما، ويطلب "داك فيليبس" من "بيت" ردّ صنيع، بينما يعترف "دون" بجزء من ماضيه ويخفف من حمله.

14.o: يجتمع "دون" مرة أخرى بـ "ستيفاني" التي تمنحه دعوة، وتتولى "سالي" مسؤولية كبيرة، بينما تستخدم "جون" فهرس البطاقات استخدامًا جيدًا.

Episode Two begins with the political infighting that threatened to swamp Lincoln's administration and then follows Union General George McClellan's ill-fated campaign on the Virginia Peninsula, where his huge army meets a smaller but infinitely more resourceful Confederate force. Convinced by July 1862 that emancipation was now morally and militarily crucial to the future of the Union, Lincoln must wait for a victory to issue his proclamation. But as the year wears on there are no Union victories to be had, thanks to the brilliance of Stonewall Jackson and Robert E. Lee. The episode comes to a climax in September 1862 with Lee's invasion of Maryland. During the episode we learn of fierce Northern opposition to Lincoln's Emancipation Proclamation, the miseries of regimental life and the increasing desperation of the Confederate homefront. As the episode ends, Lee decides to invade the North again to draw Grant's forces away from Vicksburg.

For three days 150,000 men will fight to the death in the Pennsylvania countryside, culminating in Pickett's legendary charge. This extended episode then goes on to chronicle the fall of Vicksburg, the New York draft riots, the first use of black troops, and the western battles at Chickamauga, Georgia and Chattanooga, Tennessee. In 30 days, the two armies lose more men than both sides have lost in three years of war. The stakes are nothing less than the survival of the Union itself: with Grant and Sherman stalled at Petersburg and Atlanta, opinion in the North has turned strongly against the war. 8.o: The episode begins with William Tecumseh Sherman's brilliant march to the sea, which brings the war to the heart of Georgia and the Carolinas and spells the end of the Confederacy. In March, following Lincoln's second inauguration, first Petersburg and then Richmond finally fall to Grant's army. Lee's tattered Army of Northern Virginia flees westward towards a tiny crossroads town called Appomattox Court House. There the dramatic and deeply moving surrender of Lee to Grant takes place. The episode ends in Washington where John Wilkes Booth begins to dream of vengeance for the South.

9.t: The Better Angels of Our Nature: 1865
9.o: This extraordinary final episode of The Civil War begins in the bittersweet aftermath of Lee's surrender and then goes on to narrate the horrendous events of five days later when, on April 14, Lincoln is assassinated. After chronicling Lincoln's poignant funeral, the series recounts the final days of the war, the capture of John Wilkes Booth and the fates of the Civil War's major protagonists. The episode then considers the consequences and meaning of a war that transformed the country from a collection of states to the nation we are today.

1.o: Kouhei is a single dad living with his daughter, Tsumugi. He's busy and doesn't know how to cook, so he feeds her nothing but frozen foods and lunches from the convenience store. But when a chance encounter with a student of his gives him the opportunity to feed her a home-cooked meal, he leaps at it.

2.o: Kouhei is worried about meeting with Kotori, his student. Is it okay for him to be meeting with an individual student outside of class? But Tsumugi is too young to know or care about the rules of the adult world, and what's more, Kotori has the promise of pork soup to tempt them both.

3.t: Tsumugi and the Long-Awaited Hamburg Steak
3.o: Tsumugi gets into a fight at daycare, and it spoils her mood for good cooking. Even the long-awaited Hamburg steak isn't enough to rouse her from her gloom. Can Kotori and Kouhei come up with a way to cheer her up so she can enjoy her meal? And will she find out how much her daddy really loves her?

4.t: Hated Vegetables and Bits in Gratin
4.o: Tsumugi is like many young kids: she hates her veggies. Particularly those nasty green peppers! Is it possible for a child to like green peppers? Kouhei and Kotori decide to try and find out by making a delicious and tempting "roll-y" gratin that smothers those wicked peppers with cheese!

5.t: A Day Off and Special Doughnuts
5.o: Tsumugi has a problem: she finds doughnuts difficult. Are they a snack? Are they a meal? She finds the answer when Kotori and her father make homemade doughnuts, a feat she didn't even know was possible. But can Kouhei handle frying foods without burning them?

6.o: Tsumugi wants to throw a party: a gyoza party! And a party means that she can invite all her friends, everyone she knows at daycare, and Kotori, and Shinobu, and even Yagi! But she's just a little girl, and doesn't know that you have to get permission from Kotori's mom before you can hold a party at Kotori's house. How can Kouhei resolve this sticky situation? And what's the best way to make gyoza, anyway?

7.t: Gohei Mochi and a Grand Adventure
7.o: Oh no! Dad is sick! Tsumugi wants to get him something to make him feel better, and she's willing to brave fierce sharks, dark caves, and giant dogs to make her way to Kotori's house. But what will dad do when he wakes up and finds her gone? And what can Kotori do with this batch of rice she just burnt?

8.t: Squid and Taro Stew That's Still Yummy Tomorrow
8.o: Kouhei wants to do something nice for his daughter. When his first idea is shot down, he decides to make her one of mommy's old dishes instead. Tsumugi choses squid and taro stew, a dish for grown-ups! Kouhei masters the art of chopping up a squid and peeling a taro, as Tsumugi attains enlightenment by looking into the squid's eyes.

9.o: It's sleepover night at the preschool! The class is making curry, just like you'd make at home. But Tsumugi's "at-home curry" is different than usual. It's got raisins! Kouhei decides to make Tsumugi the special keema curry that her mother used to make. But how will Tsumugi react to this memory of her mother?

10.o: Tsumugi has decided that she's a cat! When Kouhei gets an ice chest full of yummy fish, she's more than excited to watch him make them! But to make namerou, or as Kotori calls it, "fish hamburg steak" you have to be able to filet the fish, and Kouhei doesn't know how! To make matters worse, neither does anyone else! Can he turn to the internet for help?

11.t: A Play and Sweet Potato Crêpes
11.o: It's the week of the play, and Tsumugi wants to be Mr. Galigali, the fluffy mascot of her favorite TV show. But trouble breaks out when her friends want her to be a magical girl. When Kouhei tries to cheer her up with talk of delicious sweet potato crepes, she snaps! "Daddy! All you ever talk about is food!" Can dad show that he really loves her? Will Kotori get to eat her sweet potato crepes? And will Mr. Galigali be able to help save the world in the school play?

12.o: It's the one-year anniversary of Tsumugi's mother's death, and she and Kouhei go to the countryside to attend the funeral. On the night after they get back, Kouhei is too tired to cook, so they go to an okonomiyaki restaraunt. But Tsumugi throws a fit when she finds out it's not what she thought. Kotori offers to make her real okonomiyaki to make her feel better. This time the whole gang drops in, even Kotori's mom!

1.o: Change is in the air for the players of the deadly game. Fed up with his aunt, Kato finds a new place to live with his little brother. Meanwhile, Kei’s attitude pushes Kishimoto away, and Tetsu’s life spirals brutally out of control.

2.o: The Gantz calls the players for another round. Among the new faces gathered before the sphere: a television evangelist that thinks he has all the answers and a girl who seems willing to give Kei the attention he seeks.

3.o: When Kato shares what he knows in an effort to help the new players, the evangelist begins to think something sinister is afoot. The holy man learns just how correct he is as the game’s new targets make their presence known.

4.t: I Can Shoot Them, Can't I?
4.o: The team’s efforts to defeat the giant aliens are hindered by two thugs who are brutally tormenting a homeless man - the very same homeless man that Kei and Kato encountered just before their deaths.

5.o: Kei goes on a rampage, leading the battle against the giant aliens. Yet another unhappy surprise awaits the team.

6.o: After claiming victory against the giant red and green aliens, the group boldly rushes into battle against the smaller statues. Soon enough, they find their numbers thinned by an enormous new enemy.

7.o: Several players meet with gruesome ends as the living statues continue their onslaught. Tragically, one of the mutilated victims is someone very dear to Kato and Kei.

8.o: The carnage continues and truly no one is safe. As wounded Kei struggles to stay alive, his teammates fall one after the other. When the final foe is defeated, only one player will be around to see the score.

9.o: Kei returns to the Gantz and finds many familiar faces will be joining him in battle. Unfortunately, Kei is shocked to see that their alien prey wears a familiar face as well.

10.o: With no explanation, the Gantz has chosen Kei to be hunted. At first, the rest of the players are unsure of what they should do - but the black sphere soon helps them decide that Kei should die.

11.o: The new players are beginning to see just how dangerous the two bum-killing freaks really are. As the situation escalates, the members of the team look to the one person who might be able to help them survive - Kei.

12.o: Madness is taking over as the team hunts the two brutal maniacs in their midst. The number of fatalities grows quickly, and Kei begins to understand that the Gantz might not be his worst problem.

13.o: Facing his deadliest foe, Kei is forced to question everything he’s learned—and all that he has lost—in the twisted world of the Gantz. No matter if he lives or dies, for Kei, the game now ends.

1.o: Maruo Eiichiro is an honor student in his first year of high school. He's a very methodical person who keeps two sets of notes for class and focuses entirely on his studies. One day, Eiichiro decides to participate in a free trial at South Tennis Club (STC) because he needs some exercise. There, he meets school idol and sweetheart Takasaki Natsu. Eiichiro has taken his first step into the world of tennis

2.o: Eiichiro is unable to answer Natsu when she asks him what he enjoys doing most. He becomes interested in tennis and returns to STC for another free trial.

3.o: Eiichiro is unable to forget how good it felt when he successfully returned Takuma's serve, and he spends all of his time practicing against the wall. After seeing Eiichiro practice against the wall non-stop for six hours on a Sunday, Natsu predicts that he will quickly improve.

4.o: Eiichiro finds himself in a contest with Takuma. Eiichiro has fifty tries to return Takuma's serve. One successful return and Eiichiro wins. However, despite Eiichiro's best attempts to follow his notes and stick to the basics, he can do nothing against one of the strongest serves in the country.

5.t: A First Match Full of Surprises
5.o: Eiichirō is about to play his first match. He receives advice from the other STC members, but it only makes him more nervous. He doesn't get a chance to calm himself down as he's soon called to the tennis court.

6.o: It is down to the final match of the set. Eiichirō trails 5 games to 1, but with a determination to stay on the court as long as possible Eiichirō begins to push Oobayashi.

7.o: In order to improve Eiichirō's playing, Coach Miura has him learn control on a 9-square court. After getting the basics done, Eiichirō is forced into a match against Takuma.

8.o: Maruo Eiichirō continues his training at STC as he tries to master every shot. At smaller tournaments he begins advancing to the third round but is unable to go further. His mother worries that Eiichirō is spending too much time on tennis when he drops out of cram school to practice more.

9.o: Eiichirō returns to the Kanagawa Junior Circuit. His first match is up against fellow high school student Koshimizu Nariyuki, a man whom is always trying to compete with Eiichirō for the top scores.

10.o: The match between Eiichirō and Miyagawa begins with each holding serve. However Eiichirō feels that something is off. After studying his notes, Eiichirō realizes that Miyagawa has been studying his shots, and with a 4-3 lead he plans on making his move in the eighth game.

11.o: After managing to hold serve Eiichirō starts looking for an opportunity to break Miyagawa. Both hold serve and force a tiebreaker. With the score 6-5 Maruo in the tiebreaker Eiichirō decides to try and gamble to use his full stroke and steal a point.

12.o: After defeating Miyagawa, Eiichirō returns to STC for some training that will make him better in 1 day. Eiichirō is teamed up with a Coach Mike from Florida who specializes in pyschological training.

13.o: The match between Hiromi and Eiichirō begins. Everytime Eiichirō tries to go on the attack, Hiromi hits a shot Eiichirō can't reach.

14.o: It is match 10 of a 1-set match, and Eiichirō leads 5 games to 4. Eiichirō begins to up his speed against Hiromi, and with it he stays even at 30-30. Just then Hiromi's legs cramp up, allowing Eiichirō to get two easy aces and win the match 6-4.

15.o: Eiichirō overhears Araya telling Takuma that if he loses to him this tournament, he will retire from tennis. His plan is to defeat Takuma and then announce he is going pro. Takuma agrees to tell Eiichirō Araya's weaknesses.

16.o: After going up Love-15, Araya uses a number of service aces to go up 3-1 in set 2. Eiichirō holds serve, and as he gains a 30-40 advantage in Game 6 of Set 2, Araya punches himself in his face to eliminate his emotions from the game.

17.o: Araya and Eiichirō end up at deuce after neither player can gain an advantage. An ace end up being huge for Araya give him the match point advantage, and despite his best efforts a lucky bounce proves to be the end for Eiichirō as he loses 6-1, 6-4. The finals are held between Araya and Takuma.

18.o: Eiichirō investigates going Pro, but his reaction from his parents is less than he expected. Eiichirō joins Natsu at the first round of the All Japan Pro to watch the debut match of Ike Souji.

19.o: Eiichirō manages to steal 1-point in the 10-minute match with Ike before his coaches reappear and make him stop playing a match. Afterwards Eiichirō is sent home to rest. The next day Eiichirō begins a brutal practice regimen that will recondition his body into that of a pro's.

20.o: Eiichirō participates in a tournament after 3 months of hellish training. He learns about active rest while participating in the tournament and makes it to the final. Terashima is his opponent.

21.o: Eiichirō continues his practice and gets his next tournament schedule. As the last player to qualify he is placed up against the 1-seed, Yu Nabae. Eiichirō begins to look for weaknesses from Yu on tape, but what he finds is a highly adaptive style that could easily beat him if he doesn't come up with a few tricks.

22.o: Yu Nabae matches up with Eiichirō and realizes they really are two players that are virtually the same. He realizes that what Eiichirō lacks is experience with the fundamentals, as he has never played anyone like himself, and after losing the first set Nabae begins to pull away and goes up 5-2.

23.o: In an effort to try and reverse the tide, Eiichirō decides to go back to his idea of having 100-squares to aim for instead of 9.

24.o: Eiichirō runs to watch Natsu's match when he learns she is in danger of losing. Afterwards they return to STC where he Ryuhei Aoi, a man who will become his new coach.

25.o: Eiichirō and Natsu go out on their first date. When Eiichirō asks Natsu what she thinks about him, she tells him he is cheating. Afterwards Eiichirō is allowed to resume practice.

1.o: It is the year 1997, and aliens have taken over most of Eurasia. Humanity fights back with giant robots called TSFs, but is gradually losing ground to endless alien armies. Now the aliens are advancing on Japan, and Yui Takamura, a trainee at the Imperial Guard Academy, will have to battle them.

2.o: The BETA have invaded Japan, and are advancing on Kyoto. An alien vanguard breaks through the Japanese lines, and attacks Yui's supply base. Badly outnumbered and cut off from support, she has no choice but to flee...

3.o: Yuuya Bridges, an elite American test pilot, has been sent to a backwoods Alaskan base to test the next generation of TSFs. But he hasn't even arrived when two other test pilots wander off the course in a deadly game of cat and mouse, and they're heading straight for his plane...

4.o: Yuuya Bridges, the new American test pilot at Yukon base, is struggling with his first assignment: a joint project between the US and Japanese militaries. To master his new TSF, he must first learn to think like the Japanese, and that means confronting his own past...

5.o: Yuuya continues his attempts to master the Japanese TSFs, to little success. During one last exercise, an unknown TFS suddenly appears on the practice ground, and it's heading straight for him...

6.o: As part of a morale-building exercise, Argos Flight is sent to the Caribbean for a photo shoot. During a boat race, Yui, Cryska, and Yuuya are stranded on a deserted island. Cryska gets sick, and an injured Yui tries to force herself to help, but the rain is getting worse...

7.o: Yui, Yuuya, and Cryska are trapped on a deserted island in the middle of a terrible rainstorm. With potentially a full week until they're found by the rest of the military, they're forced to try and work out their differences from the confines of their small cave...

8.o: Argos Flight is sent to the front lines of the U.S.S.R. to get real combat data in their TSFs. At the same time, Yuuya is assigned to test a brand new EM cannon, keeping him back in a support role. But things aren't as peaceful on a front line base as they are back in the Yukon...

9.o: It's finally time for Yuuya's first battle: A carefully scripted fight against a limited number of BETA that will allow him to test both his TSF and the new prototype cannon. But things quickly go off script as the BETA overwhelm the front lines, and if he doesn't act fast, the entire team could be wiped out.

10.o: Yuuya destroyed over 3000 BETA with a single cannon blast. The whole base throws him a party, but instead of attending he spends the evening staring up at his TSF. He begs Yui for a chance at some real close-range combat experience, but changing the schedule, she says, will be very difficult.

11.o: A massive force of underground BETA is heading towards the Soviet Base, and there's no time to do anything but pack up and leave. Yui stays behind to destroy the Type 99 Cannon, but the Soviets want it for themselves...

12.t: The End of a Deadly Battle
12.o: Yui is trapped in the abandoned supply base, and the BETA have broken through the defense lines. With no hope of escape, she attempts to destroy the prototype cannon to keep it from falling into the wrong hands...

13.o: Yuuya rescues Yui from the hangar, and tries to escape with the core for the EM Radiation Cannon. But all the BETA suddenly start heading towards them, and they have to make a quick escape...

14.o: Yuuya is forced to flee as the BETA overwhelm the base and Russian bombers advance. With no hope of recovering the EM Cannon's core module, he staggers home as the Zhar Battalion launches a last-ditch effort to keep the entire Far East defense line from collapsing.

15.o: The team returns safely to Alaska and throws a party to celebrate. The party is interrupted by the leader of the Chinese Bao Feng Squad, Cui Yifei. She has more than a passing interest in Yuuya...

16.o: In the first stage of the Blue Flag exercises, Argos Flight is pitted against the Chinese Bao Feng. With Tarisa flying the new Shiranui unit 2, Argos is badly outmatched, when Yuuya challenges their leader to a duel.

17.o: The Blue Flag exercises are in full swing, and America shows off its Raptor and its advanced stealth technology, but after the fight, Yuuya finds himself running from the MPs in the city after the Scarlet Twins tell him they need to talk to him urgently...

18.o: Vincent wins big by betting on the first round of Blue Flag, and takes the whole Test Flight out for drinks. Yuuya sits in a corner and talks to the bartender. Meanwhile, Cui wants to talk to Lt. Takamura about Yuuya...

19.o: To deal with the increasing rivalries between the nations competing in Blue Flag, the higher-ups involved in the Prominence project decide to send the Eishi on a wilderness backpacking trip. On the way to their destination, they encounter a bear. It turns out the bear is actually a hot springs...

20.o: Everyone is so focused on the fight with the BETA and improving their forces to fight the menace, that they forget to look at how their society is forced to live. Tensions build, and sometimes that leads to action. Total Eclipse is no exception.

21.o: Chaos ensues and no one is sure what is going on, and who is attacking from where. The Argos Test Flight team meet up and attempt to repel a force attacking for seemingly unknown purposes, but who will come out on top when no one knows who they can trust?

22.o: Yuuya fights 24 TSFs to buy time for the rest of Argos to escape, and is only saved by the timely intervention of Inia. Before the enemy commander goes down, however, she's planning on taking Cui with her...

23.t: The Victory Song of the Dead
23.o: A mass of BETA are rushing towards the Red Line. If they get there, Red Shift will activate and destroy Alaska. Sandek has a plan to stop them, and the only ones who can carry it out are Argos Squad.

24.o: Yuuya fights a final battle with the Scarlet Twins and the BETA to stop Red Shift from activating and destroying Alaska.

1.o: Explores the new global honey business, and largest food fraud investigation and prosecution in history—a scam known as "honeygate."

2.o: In the last twenty years, there’s been a surge of people suffering from severe food allergies. A look at the swelling body of science around this change, and the accountability of restaurateurs in caring for their most vulnerable customers.

3.o: A lucrative and controversial commerce relationship between the US and China forms the backdrop for a David and Goliath tale of loyalty, betrayal and revenge on the American garlic scene.

4.o: From the lowliest hen to the richest magnate, the size and scale of chicken-growing has determined the fate of every player in this expansive food chain.

5.o: To boost profits, some dairy farmers are switching to produce upscale organic milk, or even "raw" unpasteurized milk, but it comes with the risk of pathogens which can sicken and even kill consumers.

6.o: In the wake of overfishing in New England, the US government stepped in to regulate and save the fisheries. The unintended result was a wave of consolidation that set the stage for massive criminal exploitation.

1.o: The avocado's rise from culinary fad to must-have superfood has made it a lucrative crop - and a magnet for money-hungry cartels.

2.o: In the south of France, frustrated winegrowers go to extremes to stave off cheap imports from Spain and new competition from China.

3.o: The explosive growth of the bottled water industry has driven corporations to dip into public water supplies and left vulnerable citizens thirsty.

4.o: Exploited workers, altered ecosystems, political power plays: Behind the scenes, Big Sugar is anything but refined.

5.o: For much of the world, chocolate is pure pleasure. But the long journey from bean to bar is packed with misery. Can an upstart company turn the tide?

6.o: New marijuana laws have sparked a surge in edible goodies, but this fast-changing foodscape comes with risks for consumers.

1.o: Mi Ka is a musical actress trying to get her big break. She has a special skill that allows her to see the remaining time that people have left on their lives. She knows that she only has 167 days left of her life and intends to make the most of it. She meets Do Ha in a car accident and ends up meeting him again in Hainan. Is their meeting a coincidence or is it destiny?

2.o: Mi Ka finds it strange why her clock stops when she is with Do Ha. She wishes to stay near him so that she can find out why, but he keeps distance from her. When Mi Ka finds out that Do Ha is holding an audition for a musical, she decides to use that as her opportunity.

3.o: Mi Ka gets a job as Do Ha’s driver. She is happy because as long as she’s near him, her clock will stop. Do Ha is confused over the feelings he has for Mi Ka. He asks her to work late and have a meal and watch a movie with him. Meanwhile, Mi Ka wonders where Do Ha’s clock is. She sneaks into the swimming to pool to find it.

4.o: Mi Ka tells Do Ha that she does not feel the same when he tells her the he likes her. However, she can’t stop thinking about his confession. Just like Mi Ka, Do Ha can’t stop thinking about what he said to her. He replays the moment in his mind and even calls Seong Bin for a consultation. Meanwhile, Do Ha’s brother, Do San, comes back to Korea.

5.o: Mi Ka tells Do Ha that she has been using him to prolong her life. Do Ha tells her that the reason she’s by his side doesn’t matter to him and gives her a kiss. Mi Ka brings Do Ha into the emergency room to help him understand what she means when she says she can see the time left in people’s lives. After speaking with Mi Ka, Do Ha decides that he must end things with Su Bong.

6.o: It turns out that So Nyeo is able to see the clocks just as Mi Ka does. Su Bong plans to convince Zhang Qi Yang to cancel the contract so that she can put pressure on Do Ha. Her intention is to interfere with Mi Ka and Do Ha’s relationship so that they can’t go any further. Do Ha figures out Su Bong’s plans and prepares a hidden card to move Qi Yang.

7.o: Joo Na’s return to Korea causes Mi Ka’s remaining time to start counting down. Joo Na is to star in the upcoming play. Mi Ka is amazed at Joo Na’s performance and slightly feels intimidated by her and her appearance on Broadway. Meanwhile, Do San is haunted again by his illness that only Mi Ka knows about.

8.o: Unable to keep her promise, Mi Ka tells Do Ha about his brother Do San’s illness and the short time he has left to live. To his dismay, he does not believe in Mi Ka's words but soon finds out the truth by going through Do San's medical records. Meanwhile, Do San asks his father, who is reluctant to any of Do San’s request, for money but only receives animosity in return.

9.o: Mi Ka realizes that the time she was gaining from being with Do Ha was actually his time. Frightened and worried, she tells Do Ha she will spend the week with her mother but stays at her friend Seong Hee's house. Meanwhile, Su Bong decides to pursue her destiny with Do Ha.

10.o: Su Bong has brunch with Mi Ka and Joo Na to tell them she will accept Do Ha’s marriage proposal. Joo Na resigns her position as the lead actress with only a few months left before the first show. Meanwhile, Do Ha does not accept Mi Ka’s unexpected farewell and pursues her for answers.

11.o: Mi Ka tells Do Ha the reason for breaking up with him; however, Do Ha still does not give up his love for her and continues to search for a way to be with her.

12.o: Director Cho faces an onslaught of pressure from Do Ha and the members of the play to quickly find a replacement for Joo Na. But, his stubbornness to do things he desires puts him out of a job. The tension heightens as Do Ha refuses to give into Su Bong’s marriage plans that causes her to take to extreme measures affecting all those around him. Meanwhile, Do Ha still can’t fully recuperate from separating from Mi Ka that catches the attention of his father.

13.o: Do Ha can’t stop thinking about Mi Ka. He visits her room and finds secret notes she has hidden in her doll. After reading the notes, Do Ha tries to piece together all of her thoughts and starts to figure out why she is avoiding him. Meanwhile, Su Bong meets with Do Ha’s father and tells him she is worried Do Ha will not come through with the wedding that drives him straight to Do Ha’s office.

14.o: Do Ha finds out that it’s him who loses time when he is with Mi Ka and waits for her at her door. Although painful, she still refuses to be with him and makes up her mind to leave everything behind. She meets with Director Cho and tries to tell him she is quitting the musical when suddenly, he calls for an urgent meeting with the cast that changes her mind. Meanwhile, Su Bong continues to try to convince Do Ha to marry her.

15.o: Su Bong’s last desperate appeal for Do Ha’s love fails. As Su Bong walks past Mi Ka, Mi Ka notices Su Bong’s time start to rapidly drop and quickly follows her to the rooftop. Knowing that the only possible thing Su Bong could be attempting is suicide, she calls Do Ha for help. Meanwhile, the musical starts to progress, and Wi Jin puts on a suit for an interview and turns up his charms for Seong Hee to notice.

16.o: With the musical finished, Mi Ka sticks to her promise with Do Ha and does whatever is asked of him. She forgets about the time that taunts her and makes the day as memorable as possible. However, her conscience can never fully let her forgot the outcome of being with Do Ha, and she makes a run for it. Soon, her mother finds out about her remaining time and does whatever it takes to save her—even begging Do Ha for help. Meanwhile, Mi Ka accepts her fate and lives her day to day when suddenly, her time starts to increase rapidly.

1.o: A revolutionary spirit lives on in modern-day Lagos, where Vandana shadows street dancers and meets Femi Kuti, the son of Afrobeat legend Fela Kuti.

2.o: From Michael Jackson's moonwalk to professional pole dancing, evolving attitudes fueled by a booming economy are changing the way Vietnam moves.

3.o: Dance unites a city of extremes in Lebanon, with stops at a wedding, a refugee camp and a nightclub bustling with belly dancers.

4.o: The island of Bali delivers a dizzying mix of sacred movement, hip-hop collaborations and ecstatic dance parties drawing people from around the world.

5.o: Parisian dance culture includes an eclectic mix of styles, from ballet and burlesque to underground vogue balls and hip-hop battles.

1.o: Seung Joo used to be a freelancing producer who directed her own TV shows. She lands a job at UBS Broadcasting Station, and she is excited to start a new chapter of her life. However, the society has prejudice on women who live alone. Right then, she meets Jak Doo. (Source: Kocowa)

Harby celebrates his birthday with his family, and they also celebrate the New Year. Abeer, Harby's wife, presents him, Harby rejects the idea of his sister Safia’s work with Souad, Farida, who works with her Harbi, is attacked by Karim and asks for help from Harby

2.o: Harby saves Farida and beats Karim. Karim reports Harby to the police and Harby gets arrested. Harby's youngest sister, Sabah, falls ill. Harby asks the persecution to question Farida and her friend Zeina, but both girls testify against him.

3.o: The police search Harby's house to locate the stolen items as Karim puts the loot in Harby's room in the villa. Farida sees Karim and takes the loot from Harby's room to hide it. She tells Karim that he has to stay away from Harby if he wants to get engaged to her.

4.o: When Harby beats Karim in the police station, Karim vows revenge and threatens Harby. Safeya decides to find a job but her fiancé is against it. Farida's father sets a date for Farida and Karim's engagement. The sales rep, Nour, gets robbed.

5.o: After Nour is robbed, the store manager wants her to either get an unregistered marriage or write him a promissory note if she doesn't want him to report her to the police. Safeya asks Farida to get Karim to drop the charges against Harby.

6.o: Harby is welcomed back into his neighborhood after he is released. Harby fights with Safeya when he learns that she went to Farida. Karim sends thugs to beat Harby. Farida visits Harby and he vows revenge on Karim in front of her.

7.o: Harby starts working for Gamal who bought a car for Harby to work on. When Madame Suzy sends Safeya to Farida to deliver her engagement dress, Harby grows mad at Safeya. Karim and Farida get engaged.

8.o: Harby fights with Safeya and slaps her. Souna gives Harby money to buy Safeya's trousseau. Karim's uncle asks Madame Suzy about Safeya whom he saw dancing during Farida and Karim's engagement party.

9.o: The store manager demands fifty thousand pounds from Nour and makes her choose between marrying him or going to prison. Farida and Karim quarrel over the latter's affairs. Sabah goes missing and the family looks for her.

10.o: Harby finds Sabah and chastises her for wandering off. Harby prepares for Safeya's wedding. When Suzy sends Nour to a guy who tries to come onto Nour, Nour breaks a vase on the guy's head.

11.o: Nour flees the guy who tries to assault her. Safeya and Saber get married. Farida comes to congratulate Safeya on her marriage.

12.o: Karim quarrels with Farida when he learns that she went to Safeya's wedding. Harby gains fame after he saves the officers at a checkpoint from a dangerous terrorist.

13.o: Harby's wife gives birth but their newborn daughter is sick and requires the NICU. Madame Suzy drugs Safeya and takes photos of her in a compromising position to threaten her with.

14.o: Saber quarrels with Safeya when he notices the change in her demeanor. Suzy threatens Safeya with her photos and Nour with the guy to whom she gave the promissory note.

15.o: Saber tells Harby about the change in Safeya's behavior and shares his suspicions that she is hiding something. After Farida's car breaks down, she meets Harby and asks to see his baby daughter, Safeya.

16.o: Souna's bakery burns down. Safeya enlists Farida's help with Suzy. Saber and Harby grow worried when they can't find Safeya. When Farida and Safeya confront Suzy, the latter hit Farida on the head as someone gags Safeya.

17.o: Saber and Harby look for Safeya in various hospitals and police stations. Sabah sees a dream that shows her siblings in danger. Harby gets an anonymous phone call informing him that his sister is at a brothel. Harby finds Farida in Suzy's house.

18.o: Nour helps Harby flee Suzy's trap. Safeya's body is found in Suzy's villa and her father and husband go to identify her. When Suzy is questioned, she accuses Harby of killing Safeya. Farida vanishes.

19.o: Saber informs Harby of Safeya's death. The devastated Harby is forced to flee when the police arrive to arrest him for killing his sister.

20.o: Karim kidnaps Harby's wife to force Harby to reveal Farida's location. Harby enlists the help of Molkat, his old prison mate. Harby confronts Karim and Farida's father. Karim aims a gun at Harby and Abeer.

21.o: Molkat saves Harby and Abeer. Harby gets Hanan to provide information about Zizo, the guy who appears in the compromising video with Safeya.

22.o: Sherif advises Suzy to stay with his secretary until Harby is arrested. As the family prepares to buy Safeya, Harby sneaks in to see her one last time.

23.o: When the police try to search the house during Safeya's memorial service, Abeer stands up to them. Farida's mother tries to kill herself. Harby and Molkat find Zizo.

24.o: Harby takes Zizzo to the cemetery and forces him to confess the truth in front of everyone. Zizzo admits that he never touched Safeya and that Suzy drugged her and had him pose with her unconscious form. Saber shoots Zizzo.

25.o: Sabah discovers a dead body among her father's swings. Harby tries to force Zizo to confess to the police. Harby decides to turn himself in after his father gets arrested for Farida's murder.

26.o: Harby tries to get his father released and begs the on-call officer to let him go. Abeer asks to see Harby. Harby is imprisoned for 15 days pending investigation.

27.o: The officer tries to convince his supervisor that Harby is being framed. Karim sends someone to break Harby out of prison, but he is actually plotting revenge on Harby.

28.o: Molkat saves Nour after Sabares tries to rape her. Suzy gets Saber to suspect Safeya's faithfulness. Karim's men kidnap Harby and try to break him out. Harby escapes after a car chase.

29.o: Sherif fights with Karim for sabotaging his plan to kill Harby in the hospital. Harby beats Sabares when he learns of his assault on Nour. Abeer loses it when she learns that Harby escaped and that the police are looking for him.

30.o: Sabares plots with Karim to bring Harby down in exchange for money. Abeer asks Harby's father to let her get a job to provide for the family. Sabah falls ill.

31.o: The police raid Zubaida's house as Karim chases Harby and shoots at him. Harby hides in Sheikh Ibrahim's house. Sabah is put in the ICU. Zeina confesses her love for Karim.

32.o: The police searched Sheikh Ibrahim's house for Harby. Saber is upset with Abeer who started looking for a job. Farida's father questions Suzy about Farida's murder.

33.o: When Sheikh Ibrahim's brothers show up to kill him for refusing to fulfill a blood feud, Harby saves him. Sherif asks his secretary to monitor Suzy to find out the identity of the big boss who is running everything.

34.o: Harby gets Sabares to monitor Ra'fat's villa. Harby confronts Ra'fat and swears to him that he didn't kill Farida. Karim arrives and tries to shoot Harby, but Zeina saves the latter.

35.o: Harby visits Sabah at the hospital. Officer Khaled gets Officer Hany to put Harby and Nour's pictures in the newspaper. Suzy turns on Sherif when he opposes the big boss's orders for her to hide in Alexandria.

36.o: Sabares tells Sherif about Harby's hiding place. Harby discovers where Suzy is and tries to get her to tell him the truth. Harby escapes when the police arrive.

37.o: Sabah is released from the hospital. Harby, Saber, and Nour hide in Soria's place. Harby questions Suzy's maid, So'ad.

38.o: Abeer dies after she grows fearful for Harby's father, Abu Regula. Harby goes to see Sharif but Sharif's wife calls security. Suze is murdered in her house.

5.o: ينطلق "فلانتينو" باحثًا عن الجاني الذي أضرّ بسمعته الماليّة، ويبدأ بالبحث عن العديد من الأشخاص الذين يملكون نفس اسمه الرباعي.

6.o: As Miu learns the truth behind Mother Hulda's story, a threatening presence prepares to destroy everything she has worked for.

1.o: في لعبة "بلانيت" الغامرة عبر الإنترنت، ينتمي "إيتشي" إلى عائلة "أكاباني" الحصينة... أمّا في حياته الواقعية، فأسرته تعيش حالة من الفوضى والتفكك.

2.o: بعد تلقي "إعلان حرب" من "القراصنة"، يذهب "شيرو" مع ولديه إلى أرض العدو لمناقشة الأمر مع القبطانة شخصيًا.

3.o: هناك شيء غريب حول الوحش الذي تقاتله عائلة "أكاباني". ومع الإحساس بالخطر، يأمر "شيرو" أسرته بتسجيل الخروج على الفور.

4.o: تتخذ "بيكو" قرارًا غير متوقع قبل اختراق الحاجز ومواجهة "إيتشي"، ثم تذهب شخصية غامضة لزيارة "أسوما".

5.o: وسط حالة من الذهول تحيط باللاعبين في كل مكان، يُظهر "شيغاتيرا" مشاعره ونواياه الحقيقية، ثم تعود "بيكو" وتطالب بتوضيح.

6.o: تشارك "بيكو" في لعبة "بلانيت" هربًا من أمها المسيطرة بصورة خانقة، لكن "شيرو" يخبرها لاحقًا بأمر يزلزل كيانها.

7.o: يظهر "الطائر الأسود" في حياة "شيغاتيرا" الواقعية، ويذهب "تايتشيرو" ووالدته لزيارة "أسوما" في المستشفى... فتأخذهما الصدمة ممّا يكتشفانه.

8.o: يكشف "تايتشيرو" و"أسوما" لبعضهما أسرارًا مكتومة منذ زمن طويل، وتظهر المرأة الغامضة مرة أخرى وتحذر "أسوما" من تسجيل الدخول إلى "بلانيت" مجددًا.

9.o: تكشف "هانا" لـ"تايتشيرو" و"أسوما" عن تورط والدهما في "بلانيت" و"الطائر الأسود" وأمور أخرى، ثم يحكي "تايتشيرو" لـ"هانا" عن شقيقته الصغرى.

10.o: يُصاب جميع أفراد الأسرة بالعدوى ويعودون إلى "بلانيت"... غير أنّ هذا العالم المظلم لا يضاهي الجنة المشمسة التي هربوا إليها في يوم من الأيام.

11.o: يرغب "كوجيرو" في رؤية أسرته قبل مغادرتهم إلى ملجأ ناءٍ، لكن "أسوما" يطلب منه البقاء بعيدًا. ويطرح "ساسوماتا" على "شيرو" سؤالًا غريبًا.

12.o: بصفته "إيتشي"، يشرع "تايتشيرو" بمهاجمة "ليون" الذي يشعر بالغضب والانكسار. وأثناء ذلك، يكشف "شيرو" لـ"ساسوماتا" أنه أطلق عليه اسمًا مختلفًا عندما ابتكره.

1.o: يُمعن أفراد عائلة "سيووتر" التفكير في معلم محبوب كان موجودًا في حياتهم عام 1961. ومع تكشّف عهد الإرهاب على يد قاتل "الزودياك"، يظهر مشتبه به مروّع.

2.o: ينقطع "ألين" عن التواصل مع عائلة "سيووتر" بعد رحلة إلى مدينة جامعية، حيث يُعثر على طالبة مقتولة. وبعد مرور عدة سنوات، يكشف معلمهم المتعثر عن سرّ غامض.

3.o: بينما يسعى الأشقاء لفهم طبيعة علاقة أمهم مع "ألين" الحقيقية، تساعدهم هدية غريبة وصندوق من الأدلة للاقتراب من الحقيقة.

1.o: Caesar watches as the slave and gladiator, Tyrannus, slaughters his competitors, unaware that Cassius and Brutus -- Caesar's "friends" -- plan to assassinate him shortly, an event foretold by the psychic vestal virgin, Camane. After the assassination, Caesar's murderers seek to take over the empire, but standing in their way is a will naming Caesar's nephew, Octavius, as heir. Keeping a promise made to Caesar, Tyrannus spirits Octavius away from those who now want him dead.

2.o: Marc Antony addresses the crowd at Caesar's funeral, where a shroud hides the deceased leader's stab wounds. Octavius' mother, Atia, recently imprisoned by Cassius, is allowed to speak at Caesar's funeral, but she tells the wild crowd that her son is Caesar's true heir. Meanwhile Camane, the psychic vestal virgin, has put her own life at risk by guarding the will, and Tyrannus, fearing for Octavius' life, once again takes the young heir away from the turbulence of Rome.

3.o: Camane posts signs around Rome claiming that Octavius is Caesar's rightful heir. Under Tyrannus's protection  Octavius is on the run because Cassius wishes him dead. The two are captured by mercenaries and put into a gladiator's prison where they will face certain death if their true identities are revealed.

4.o: Though Octavius believes they are safe at Marc Antony's villa, Tyrannus doesn't trust his host and, after arguing with both Octavius and Antony, he leaves the villa. It turns out that Tyrannus had good reason to distrust the ambitious Antony, who arranges to have Octavius bitten by a poisonous snake and leaves him to die.

5.o: Camane, the beautiful Vestal Virgin, saves Octavius' life after he is bitten by a poisonous snake. When Marc Antony's soldiers arrive suddenly to assassinate Octavius, Camane puts herself in harm's way so the young Emperor can escape and hopefully claim his throne.

6.o: Octavius decides to give up the beautiful Vestal Virgin, Camane, and to devote himself to what he was born to -- the position of Emperor of Rome. The former slave and gladiator, Tyrannus, joins Octavius' forces in the midst of battle to fight against the power-driven Marc Antony, as the fate of Rome and the western world hang in the balance.

1.t: A Big Home for a Big Prize
1.o: Rick & Lorie won the Lottery's Mega Millions jackpot of $180 million dollars and are looking for their dream home in Riverside County, California. Host David Bromstad is asked to find a modern, country style home to make Millionaire memories. It should include a large amount of acreage, a big kitchen, 6 or more bedrooms and a place for Lorie's Dad to call home.

2.o: Joe & Rhonda won $11.7 million in the Minnesota Lottery and are looking for a new dream home near beautiful Stillwater. Host David Bromstad travels back to his birth state to help the couple search for a mansion in the range of $2.5 million. He needs to find a treasure with an open floor plan, a big kitchen, up to 40 acres, 4 bedrooms and hopefully a big enough barn for Rhonda's hobby sport of agility training for German Shepherds.

3.o: Design expert, David Bromstad takes New Jersey's newest Lottery winners on a tour to find an amazing new Dream Home. They have a total of $7 million to spend but will they choose $1.65 million 'Old Indian Estate', the historical 'Llewellyn Carriage House', or brand new build 'The Ryserson' in their old neighborhood? Whatever they choose, it's going to be fabulous.
